notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
Reworked the balance of upgrade prices.

 Replaced the sound of a shot of the player's main weapon.

 The design of some levels has been changed.

 Reduced the number of mines on the third level.

 Fixed many minor bugs.

notes.title: FPS limitation option
notes.content: Added option to limit the number of frames per second.
